goal_scope: Complete all three stages of section VI, seeking physically important, independently verified predictive structure from Gaussian distributions beyond strong baselines; do not redefine success as a benchmark
evidence: Seventeenth round: full-Gaussian two-transfer symbols, physical phase-cycled count readout, and strong stochastic controls. 288 label cases, 1048576 independent Haar checks, 44 evaluated trajectories (28 new), all 10 canonical gates fail. Angular SMF/DTWA:1572864 independent samples; original uniform model:524288 independent samples and36 saved-state controls. Existing conditioned-Jastrow fit captures original-pulse curvature with L2 error0.005357, versus pair-CC1.424565. No canonical-specific important discovery or new parameter forecasts.

phase1.physics_window: verified on saved finite-size time grids

phase2.onsite_PBCS: multistart feasible fits plus counting exclusion; no global fit certificate
phase2.general_projected_Gaussian: Arbitrary-orbital fixed-N feasible fits remain local. Sixth-round count theorem is strengthened to arbitrary Hermitian one-body weighted observables. At the original L12 G2 t=2.15 pulse, a fixed rational energy-weighted observable now gives an exact rational exclusion: 1-F_PG > 1.10249e-10, using integer Taylor evolution and a rigorous norm remainder. This is extremely weak and does not prove the large local-fit error is unavoidable.
phase2.stochastic: Gaussian-noise SMF and discrete TWA; two seeds, two time steps, eight GPUs
phase2.collective_radial: optimized free complex radial coefficients and an m-dependent-orbital variant
phase2.full_Haar_canonical_Husimi: 32768-sample pilot and weighted reservoirs saved; k2 canonical mass about 1526
phase2.adaptive_Gaussian_column_generation: 32 symmetry-orbit columns, three times, two seeds; onsite 12 starts plus arbitrary pairing-matrix 2 starts per column; local matching pursuit, no global oracle
phase2.coherent_kernel_and_phase_ablation: Full off-diagonal kernels; atom deletion changes initial FCS; additional sector phase controls preserve every p(m)
phase2.cost_repairs: SOCP with exact-algebra Fock residual repair; analytic-support magic witness bounds; float64, not interval certified
phase2.radial_pair_CC: New rank 1/2/3/full T with arbitrary complex transfer-sector coefficients, two seeds and eight starts; full-rank feasible fidelity at first pulse 0.95996725
phase2.conditioned_orbitals: Independent onsite pair/hole orbital profiles per m, with arbitrary coherent radial coefficients; feasible first-pulse fidelity 0.99283974
phase2.density_Jastrow: Arbitrary complex two-body occupations plus arbitrary radial coefficients, polynomial count-conditioned orbitals, and their union; 36 fits / 288 starts, all selected best fits reported converged; no global local-fit certificate
phase2.Jastrow_algebraic_exclusion: Mixed-swap eight-configuration probability identity; analytic fidelity bound evaluated in float64 at pulse: F<=0.9994914373; does not apply to general projected Gaussian or mixtures
phase2.conditional_two_orbits: Two onsite orbital products per transfer count, coherent coefficients, local variable-projection fits and Hamiltonian TDVP; best feasible L12 fidelities at t=.5/1/2.15: .999999556/.999961694/.998832373. No global optimum certificate or polynomial implementation.
phase2.projected_Gaussian_convex_hull: QFI <= 4 mean(m), hence K(0)-K(theta) <= theta^2 mean(m) for mixtures of normalized total-number-projected pure Gaussian states. This coherent certificate excludes classical mixtures; ordinary mixed-state count variance does not. No additional many-body projection is allowed.
phase2.nonlinear_pair_CC_extension: Hermitian Dirac-Frenkel pair-CC and projective right-ket CC, plus source-only ablation; four odd-grid conditions from the same exact Fermi sea. The projective right-ket observable convention is distinguished from bivariational CC.
phase2.connected_two_transfer_extension: Full moving pair singles plus frozen connected order-two directions, independent complex radial coefficients, and Hermitian DF propagation. Direct state, k2 witness and conventional Hamiltonian-source geometries compared from the identical exact Fermi sea; no canonical-specific improvement.
phase2.weighted_projected_Gaussian_bound: For N=2M and A=c^dagger K c, Hermitian K: Var(A)<=2 Tr(gamma K^2)-Tr(gamma K)^2/M for pure total-number-projected Gaussians. QFI convexity extends the corresponding bound to their convex hull. Ordinary mixed-state variance is not bounded this way. Concavity input is classical; novelty priority and tightness unestablished.
phase2.configuration_conditioned_full_Gaussian_: At L10 G4 eta1 t1, 1,048,576 full-Fock-normalized Haar Gaussian atoms, twelve count/circulation bins, exact symmetry variance reduction; actual canonical, unoptimized cubic-moment and linear-frame coherent kernels evaluated. Weighted Haar quadrature, not iid canonical measure draws. Two count directions pass independent-half stability; mixed count/circulation only one passes.
phase2.local_Gaussian_mode_probe: Five inspected source cases, 320 onsite starts and 32 general-pairing local starts. No resolved general improvement (maximum normalized score gain <5e-10). Modes are not measure samples or global support certificates; direct and witness sources remain very similar.
phase2.nonlinear_field_geometry: Unitary Gaussian spin rotation of the two existing source fields creates higher Thouless harmonics without extra independent fields. Matched, relatively shifted and independent particle/hole profiles compared; effective rank, numerical cutoff and finite-pool coefficient cancellation explicitly retained.
phase2.angular_full_Gaussian_GPU_synthesis: Full-Gaussian k2 Cartan contraction extended to L14 (28 physical modes, SO56), with 170 invariant witness coordinates. CPU reference comparisons and analytic derivatives checked at L4/6/8. L14 t1 residual 2.2756e-10, Newton refinement 4.50e-15. Float64, no interval certificate; Gaussian dictionary is unrestricted, dense pair-index scaling remains exponential.
phase2.higher_transfer_dark_sectors: Common kernels of the two original source pair annihilators within each band. Either-band darkness at m>=2 affects later counts more than m1 darkness. This is not a full-Hamiltonian invariant subspace, a long-lived subradiant state or a new phase claim.
phase2.dark_coherent_information: Population-coordinate full-Gaussian coherent moments use 262144 then 4194304 independent Haar atoms with shared fixed calibration. No direction passes both independent-half cosine and signal/noise gates. Complex overlap-ratio A/B moments are instead computed directly by full k2 Cartan derivatives; they are complex coherent labels, not positive bins or selected Gaussian atoms.
phase2.complete_coherent_response: Full 170-by-170 A and symmetric B matrices computed by exact full-Gaussian Cartan derivative formulas in floating point, not sampling. Three training-only static selection rules (largest A eigenvalues, B singular values, cross coupling to shared space), ranks1/2/4/8/16; strong basis-invariant Hamiltonian block and ordinary Arnoldi controls.
phase2.exchange_assisted_return_mode: The fifth-order dark m2 coefficient at checked flat equal-channel grids is proportional to d_p b_h+b_p d_h, with b=cos(delta), d=cos(3delta)+2cos(delta)/(r-2). Four nonzero exchange-return paths reproduce the coefficient. General-size coefficient proof and novelty unestablished; r6 norm has a factor-three aliasing exception.
phase2.temporal_full_Gaussian_cubic: C2(Uc) restricted to frozen witness-history spans retains all mixed c_i c_j c_k* coherent integrals of the full Gaussian dictionary. Eight t=.30..1.35 witnesses, ten complex coordinates, 18 real physical tangent directions. All three main cubic controls contain F and the endpoint witness, enabling both identical starts. Tensor polynomial linear spans reach170, which does not make their constrained nonlinear images full-dimensional.
phase2.paired_Cartan_monotonicity: On fixed-number seniority-zero amplitudes, complement-paired Cartan blocks have exact rational Gershgorin floors. At L14 mu=1301961/8388608. ||C2(u)-C2(v)|| >= mu ||u||^2 ||u-v||/8 gives an analytical frozen-cubic-image obstruction with a synthesis residual allowance. Domain is not arbitrary full Fock space; numerical target evaluations remain float64, not interval certificates.
phase2.actual_Gaussian_occupation_symbols: For the unrestricted full-Gaussian k2 dictionary, single physical-mode mean-occupation insertions have three copy-occupation eigenvalues. All functions of one such occupation produce a vector in the same three contracted sectors.112 deterministic contractions and224 derivatives at four existing early times;1,048,576 Haar atoms provide independent checks. These are full-Fock physical labels, not projected-atom count ratios or target marginal observables.
phase2.actual_Gaussian_pair_symbols: Full-Fock labels <s_i+ s_j->, Delta_i*Delta_j and the normal-density minor are integrated separately using second-Cartan symbol insertions. Particle-number-changing paired and complementary broken-pair sectors are retained.128 label cases,384 component vectors; independent third/fourth-Cartan and two Haar batches check normalization.Offsite M_anomalous-M_full/3 vanishes on every paired occupation-basis Slater witness; the label itself does not vanish pointwise.
phase2.actual_Gaussian_two_transfer_symbols: Full eight-fermion Wick labels; number-changing and four-broken-mode intermediates retained; k2. Cross-copy subtraction is not a probability bin or physical cumulant.

At t2 count TV .009638/.013242; the mode captures .189372/.213508 of all higher-transfer dark probability. Not a canonical-selected mechanism or an implemented experimental intervention.

A subsequent analytically Gaussian-background-subtracted contrast pilot adds4 spaces/8 trajectories and fails4 more gates. next_required_work: Identify a physically important relation revealed by Gaussian distributions beyond the tested conventional controls. Static higher-degree moments alone have not supplied it.
Conditioned-orbital and higher-cluster propagation remain relevant controls for angular-model readout; original-model fitted capacity is not a predictive comparison.
Freeze a supported candidate before genuinely unseen spectra/couplings, preserving identical initial states for deletion and controls.
Do not treat estimated Monte Carlo errors, finite saved-space capacity, local fits, or existing phase-cycling identities as global certificates or new physics.
scientific_conclusion: Original goal remains incomplete. Two-transfer coherence has a concrete count readout and exposes pair-CC/SMF/DTWA errors. Canonical-derived coordinates do not beat ordinary Hamiltonian controls. Original-model conditioned orbital/Jastrow representations capture the signal well without canonical synthesis; saved fits are capacity controls, not forecasts.

physical_phase_diagnostics.finding: Opposing transfer-sector currents coexist at the first mean pulse; count and collective four-point matching do not determine future variance
physical_phase_diagnostics.failed_interpretation: Counterflow does not imply new independent pairing channels; the exactly one-direction-per-band model also shows it

resource_use: Eight H20s used for Haar checks, Gaussian symbol training, and both stochastic-control batches. CPU pulse computations used six workers; numerical libraries one thread per process. No experiment jobs running at publication checkpoint.

conditional_mechanism.scope: Transfer number correlated with intraband pair-orbital shape and phase
conditional_mechanism.alternative_representation: Collective density-dependent Jastrow factor multiplying a fixed projected pair state

fifth_round.superseded_causal_interpretation: Sixth-round exact own-initial-state controls show the recorded numerical gain is mainly bias cancellation, not evidence of better negativity dynamics. Original fifth-round metrics are retained.

competing_channel_extension.stage: Bounded nonlinear-baseline and canonical-training-geometry extension; original objective remains incomplete.
competing_channel_extension.model: Two flat radial shells with real cos(2theta), sin(2theta) separable kernels; initial normal Fermi sea
competing_channel_extension.verified_mechanism: For equal-strength channels, Q C_m1(t) Q = -(2i/3) t^3 Q(J_ph elementwise-cubed)Q + O(t^4). Pauli exclusion creates angular harmonics outside the original two source modes.
competing_channel_extension.limitations: Finite angular-grid aliases and exact symmetry closure are retained; no material model, spontaneous chiral order, chiral cat, novelty priority, strong-baseline superiority or canonical-only discovery claim.
competing_channel_extension.next_gate: Full pair-field/normal-exchange and Slater-vanishing contrast coordinates also fail strong prediction controls. Need a physically important connected coherent discrepancy with a justified configuration mechanism before freezing new conditions; no new phase or canonical advantage has been established.
competing_channel_extension.strong_nonlinear_baselines: Implemented Hermitian variational pair-CC, projective right-ket CC, Gaussian-seeded spin mean field and discrete TWA on four conditions; this does not exhaust all nonlinear or TDHFB alternatives.
competing_channel_extension.new_limitation: Grid k=0 appears at Taylor order r=5/7/9; do not identify it as a new continuum s-wave channel. Total out-of-source m1 weight is not the third harmonic alone.
